narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Use Case Demonstration -> Technical Specs -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for the Insta360 GO Ultra camera. It uses an emotional narrative—a husband surprising his wife with a dream gift—to demonstrate how the camera's compact size and POV capabilities can capture authentic, candid moments without being intrusive. It then transitions into a travel vlog showcase to highlight image quality and battery performance, concluding with a direct call to action using a promotional discount code.
